WITH channel_averages AS (
  SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS mean_feerate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.orderbase
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(feerate) AS mean_feerate
  FROM fees
  WHERE feerate IS NOT NULL
), above_average AS (
  SELECT c.mean_feerate, a.mean_feerate AS overall_mean
  FROM channel_averages AS c
  CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a
  WHERE c.mean_feerate > a.mean_feerate
)
SELECT AVG(mean_feerate) AS mean_average_fee_rate,
       AVG(mean_feerate - overall_mean) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM above_average;
